text: Teenagers whisper about a videotape that kills its viewers seven days after a phone call, and when her niece Tomoko dies, journalist Reiko Asakawa traces the tape to a resort cabin in Izu. She watches it, the phone screeches, and [her seven days begin|rules|death on a deadline]. With her psychic ex-husband Ryūji she follows its images to Ōshima and to Sadako, a [girl sealed inside a well|wrong|harm done to children] whose rage was recorded onto tape. When their son Yōichi watches too, Reiko learns that survival means [copying the tape for someone else|ending|the evil is handed on].
